g.text: 1N4148 diode · red LED · optional 100nF ceramic bypass
D12/D13 → 220Ω → diode A/K → LED A/K → GND1.
1N4148 black band is K. Capacitor 1 / 2 are non-polar.
100nF bypasses, when present, connect only between 5V and GND1.
Wire crossings are not junctions. Follow the insertion guide.
Axial diode leads modeled formed to 10.16mm; assembly untested.
Body envelopes use manufacturer maxima; contact and wire clearance need checking.
4 static nets · 4 components · 4 jumpers · one fixed 300-hole board
Wiring consistency only — no current, voltage, charging, switching or hardware simulation.
Arduino Uno CAD-derived geometry · illustration CC BY-SA 4.0 · sources and assumptions in component-expansion report
